title: (RHEA-2016:0467) Updated EAP 6.4 image to include RH SSO Client configuration
portal_summary: An update is now available for the Red Hat Middleware EAP 6.4 image running in OpenShift 3.1
portal_synopsis: Updated EAP 6.4 image to include RH SSO Client configuration
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.1|x86_64
portal_solution:
To update to the latest xPaaS image run the following steps to pull in the content

1. On your master host(s), ensure you are logged into the CLI as a cluster administrator or user that has project administrator access to the global "openshift" project. For example:

$ oc login -u system:admin

Then, run the following command to update the core EAP OpenShift image stream in the "openshift" project:

$ oc -n openshift import-image jboss-eap64-openshift
portal_description:
Red Hat xPaaS provides images for many of the Red Hat Middleware products for use within the OpenShift Enterprise 3.1 cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) for on-premise or private cloud deployments.

The EAP 6.4 image has been rebuilt to include the changes that are required to enable the client side integration with the Red Hat Single Sign On (RH-SSO) Technical Preview.  No changes have been made to the Middleware Product included in this image.

This update includes the following new image

repository: jboss-eap-6/eap64-openshift
tags: 1.3-10, 1.3, latest

OpenShift Enterprise 3.1 users can upgrade to this updated image.
